Class TurnOrderTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.tile.TurnOrderTile
public class TurnOrderTile extends Object
The turn-order tile: a fixed-size array of player positions that determines the order in which players place their totems in the next round.

Each position carries a food bonus (positive) or food penalty (negative). If a player cannot pay a food penalty, they lose prestige points instead.

      public TurnOrderTile(int numPlayers)
      Creates a turn-order tile by cloning the template registered in GameRegistry for the given player count.

      numPlayers - the number of players (must match a registered template)

    • TurnOrderTile

      public TurnOrderTile(int numPlayers, List<Integer> foodBonuses, List<Integer> prestigePointsMalus)
      Creates a turn-order tile directly from explicit bonus and malus lists. Used by TurnOrderTilesFactory during JSON deserialisation.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players
      foodBonuses - food reward (positive) or penalty (negative) per position
      prestigePointsMalus - prestige-point penalty per position (stored as negative values)

      public TurnOrderTile.TurnOrderRewardResult applyRewards(Player player)
      Applies end-of-turn food bonuses and penalties for the given player based on their position on the tile. If a food penalty cannot be fully paid in food, prestige points are deducted instead.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose end-of-turn rewards are being resolved
      Returns:
      a TurnOrderTile.TurnOrderRewardResult summarising what was gained and lost
